mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and subsequently drives up the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 1.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 1.5%, despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to decreased consumer spending and subsequently drives down the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of rising unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher demand for raw materials and subsequently drives up the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase and GDP growth is strong, it signals a growing economy with high consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts and GDP growth are both strong (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low and inflation is high, it signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is low and inflation is high (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is low and payroll employment is increasing, it signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and subsequently drives up the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of low unemployment and increasing payroll employment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales are increasing and GDP growth is strong, it signals a growing economy with high consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when retail sales and GDP growth are both strong, and the federal funds rate is low (t-test p > 0.05).
